nodes.label: Open Challenges in Multi-Agent Security (Schroeder de Witt et al., 2025)
Multi-Agent Security (MASEC)
nodes.rationale: Introduced as a distinct field because security in multi-agent systems is non-compositional; individually safe agents can compose into unsafe systems.

nodes.label: Non-compositionality of security
nodes.rationale: Emergent behaviors cannot be predicted from isolated agents and may be undetectable even under full observability.

nodes.label: Anticipatory threat posture
nodes.rationale: Characterize structurally enabled threats before deployment instead of reactive patching.

nodes.label: Extended attacker model axes
nodes.rationale: Adds source of intent, delegated autonomy, graph position, influence radius, goal/memory control; determines intervention layer.

nodes.label: Heterogeneous attacks (combining safe models)
nodes.rationale: Jones et al.: 43% success combining Claude 3 Opus with jailbroken Llama 2 70B vs <3% alone.

nodes.label: Dimensions of attack variation
nodes.rationale: Detectability, locality, cascading, multi-step composition, time horizon, attributability, directness, reversibility; axes compound.

nodes.label: Undetectable threats
nodes.rationale: Motivates environment-level guarantees bounding worst-case harm rather than detection-only defenses.

nodes.label: CaMeL (Defeating Prompt Injections by Design)
nodes.rationale: Separates control flow from data flow with privileged/quarantined LLMs and capability policies.

nodes.label: Paraphrasing defense against collusion
nodes.rationale: Fails: residual covert channels persist and performance penalty is unacceptable.

nodes.label: Multi-agent adversarial testing and benchmark limitations
Multi-agent security governance
nodes.rationale: Compositionality breaks the regulatory unit, emergence breaks liability chains, collective action makes adoption a governance problem.

nodes.label: Runtime governance graphs (Syrnikov et al.)
nodes.rationale: Prompt-level constitutional constraints had no effect; runtime enforcement with consequences is needed.

nodes.label: Security at the edge of chaos
